name: iMac17,1 internal audio (Intel HDA controller + Cirrus codec)

linux.summary: Internal speakers and microphone work out of the box via snd_hda_intel. Matched per model rather than by the shared 8086:a170 HDA controller, whose codec differs between iMac generations (see audio-cs8409 for 2017+).

caveats.summary: Output is stereo only; the iMac's full multi-speaker array is not driven.
caveats.detail: Sound plays but only as stereo — the additional internal speakers are not all used.
